description: This file defines a React component called DataTable, which renders a data table with features such as sticky headers, pagination, sorting, and dynamic column width calculation. It includes internal functions for measuring text width, handling sorting, pagination controls, and rendering table rows with optional edit/delete actions.

methods.name: measureTextWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a given text string using an off-screen canvas for accurate auto-width calculation, with a fallback to character count if canvas is unavailable.

methods.name: DataTable
methods.description: React functional component that renders a data table with sticky header, pagination, sorting, and dynamic column widths. Supports server-side and client-side data handling, with optional edit and delete actions.
